reading: Anthropic became one of the world's most valuable public companies after its shares began trading on the stock market.
The artificial intelligence (AI) company became publicly listed, allowing people to buy its shares.
Its valuation, or total market value, reached roughly $1.76 trillion.
Its debut, or first appearance, on the Nasdaq stock exchange was an important test for an industry receiving huge investment.
The share price quickly reached $111.53 before dropping to $97.17 by the end of the day.
Although Anthropic's shares gained roughly 17% during the day, the wider technology market did not perform as well.
A few major technology companies spent more than $1 trillion on developing AI in the last year alone.
The rapid growth in investment has raised concerns about a financial bubble, when prices rise beyond a reasonable value.
Ben Barringer, who leads technology research at Quilter Cheviot, expects significant price swings, or large movements up and down.
Neil Wilson said there was no obvious similar company to compare Anthropic with.
In the US, several politicians have said they want rules to make sure AI tools are safe.
The company, which makes the AI chatbot Claude, will face close attention as people question whether AI is worth its cost.

vocabulary.definition: An estimate of how much a company is worth.
A first public appearance, here a company's first day on the stock market.
Money put into a business or activity with the hope of gaining a future benefit.
To have particular results, either good or bad.
Worries about a problem or something that might go wrong.
A situation in which prices rise beyond a reasonable value and may later drop sharply.
Large changes in prices as they move up and down.
To examine things together to understand how they are similar or different.

entries.ja: 企業にどれほどの価値があるかについての見積もり。
entries.ko: 기업의 가치가 얼마나 되는지에 대한 추정치.
entries.zh-Hans: 对一家公司价值多少的估计。
entries.es: Una estimación de cuánto vale una empresa.
entries.pt-BR: Uma estimativa de quanto uma empresa vale.
entries.fr: Une estimation de la valeur d’une entreprise.
entries.de: Eine Schätzung, wie viel ein Unternehmen wert ist.

entries.ja: 初めて公の場に登場すること。ここでは、企業の株式が株式市場で取引される最初の日を指す。
entries.ko: 대중 앞에 처음 등장하는 것. 여기서는 기업의 주식이 주식 시장에서 처음 거래되는 날을 뜻한다.
entries.zh-Hans: 首次公开亮相，这里指一家公司的股票在股市交易的第一天。
entries.es: Una primera aparición pública; aquí, el primer día en que las acciones de una empresa se negocian en la bolsa.
entries.pt-BR: Uma primeira aparição pública; aqui, o primeiro dia em que as ações de uma empresa são negociadas na bolsa de valores.
entries.fr: Une première apparition publique ; ici, le premier jour où les actions d’une entreprise sont échangées en Bourse.
entries.de: Ein erstes öffentliches Auftreten; hier der erste Tag, an dem die Aktien eines Unternehmens an der Börse gehandelt werden.

entries.ja: 将来の利益を期待して、事業や活動に使われるお金。
entries.ko: 미래에 이익을 얻기를 기대하며 사업이나 활동에 넣는 돈.
entries.zh-Hans: 怀着将来获得收益的希望，投入企业或某项活动的资金。
entries.es: Dinero destinado a un negocio o una actividad con la esperanza de obtener un beneficio en el futuro.
entries.pt-BR: Dinheiro aplicado em um negócio ou uma atividade com a esperança de obter um benefício no futuro.
entries.fr: De l’argent consacré à une entreprise ou à une activité dans l’espoir d’en tirer un bénéfice à l’avenir.
entries.de: Geld, das in ein Unternehmen oder eine Tätigkeit gesteckt wird, in der Hoffnung, daraus künftig einen Nutzen zu ziehen.

entries.ja: 良いか悪いかにかかわらず、ある結果を出すこと。
entries.zh-Hans: 取得某种结果，无论好坏。
entries.es: Obtener determinados resultados, ya sean buenos o malos.
entries.pt-BR: Apresentar determinados resultados, sejam eles bons ou ruins.
entries.fr: Obtenir certains résultats, qu’ils soient bons ou mauvais.
entries.de: Bestimmte Ergebnisse erzielen, die gut oder schlecht sein können.

entries.ja: 問題や、何かがうまくいかなくなる可能性についての心配。
entries.ko: 문제나 무언가가 잘못될 가능성에 대한 걱정.
entries.zh-Hans: 对某个问题或可能出错的事情的担忧。
entries.es: Preocupaciones por un problema o por algo que podría salir mal.
entries.pt-BR: Preocupações com um problema ou com algo que pode dar errado.
entries.fr: Des inquiétudes au sujet d’un problème ou de quelque chose qui pourrait mal se passer.
entries.de: Sorgen wegen eines Problems oder wegen etwas, das schiefgehen könnte.

entries.ja: 価格が妥当な価値を超えて上昇し、その後急落する可能性がある状況。
entries.ko: 가격이 합리적인 가치를 넘어 상승하고 나중에 급격히 떨어질 수도 있는 상황.
entries.zh-Hans: 价格上涨到超出合理价值的水平，之后可能急剧下跌的情况。
entries.es: Una situación en la que los precios suben por encima de un valor razonable y después pueden caer bruscamente.
entries.pt-BR: Uma situação em que os preços sobem além de um valor razoável e podem depois cair bruscamente.
entries.fr: Une situation dans laquelle les prix dépassent une valeur raisonnable et peuvent ensuite chuter brutalement.
entries.de: Eine Situation, in der Preise über einen angemessenen Wert steigen und später stark fallen können.

entries.ja: 価格が上がったり下がったりする中で生じる大きな変化。
entries.zh-Hans: 价格上下波动时出现的大幅变化。
entries.es: Grandes cambios en los precios al subir y bajar.
entries.pt-BR: Grandes variações nos preços conforme eles sobem e descem.
entries.fr: De fortes variations des prix à la hausse et à la baisse.
entries.de: Große Preisveränderungen nach oben und unten.

entries.ja: 物事を並べて調べ、どのような点が似ていて、どのような点が違うかを理解すること。
entries.ko: 여러 대상을 함께 살펴보며 어떤 점이 비슷하거나 다른지 이해하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 把事物放在一起考察，以了解它们有哪些相同或不同之处。
entries.es: Examinar varias cosas en conjunto para entender en qué se parecen o se diferencian.
entries.pt-BR: Examinar coisas em conjunto para entender em que são semelhantes ou diferentes.
entries.fr: Examiner des choses ensemble pour comprendre en quoi elles se ressemblent ou diffèrent.
entries.de: Dinge gemeinsam betrachten, um zu verstehen, worin sie sich ähneln oder unterscheiden.
